arStrings.szText: Purchased from the Altar of the Eldritch at the Tree of Whispers.

Every {c_number}[{SF_2}]{/c} Resource spent, release an explosion dealing {c_random}[SF_17]{/c} Shadow damage. Each explosion triggered within {c_number}[SF_3]{/c} seconds of the last increases the size and damage by {c_number}[SF_1*100|x%|]{/c}. Stacking up to {c_number}3{/c} times.{if:SF_14} The 3rd explosion pulls enemies towards you before detonating.{/if}
The 3rd explosion pulls enemies towards you before detonating.
